description: This file defines the CreateValueResourceQuickFix class, which implements quick fix and intention actions for creating Android resource values within an IDE plugin environment, specifically for Android development in IntelliJ IDEA or Android Studio.

classes.name: CreateValueResourceQuickFix
classes.description: A class providing quick fix and intention actions for creating Android resource values within the IDE.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the quick fix, including the resource name and default resource file name.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text description of the intention action.

methods.name: getFamilyName
methods.description: Returns the family name for grouping similar quick fixes.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Indicates whether the quick fix is available in the current context.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Executes the quick fix action, calling doInvoke().

methods.name: doInvoke
methods.description: Performs the creation of the resource, handling both unit test mode and normal operation, including dialog display and resource creation.

methods.name: startInWriteAction
methods.description: Indicates whether the fix should start within a write action; returns false.

methods.name: applyFix
methods.description: Placeholder for implementing local fix; currently not implemented.
